review.body: { let first = replay_box (p , input , candidate , & record . first) ? ; let second = replay_box (p , input , & first . image , & record . second) ? ; let result = assemble (p , first , second) ? ; if result . radius != record . radius || result . one_map_radius != record . one_map_radius || result . enclosure != record . enclosure { return Err (Error :: Declaration) ; } Ok (result) }
review.item_premise: Only public rational declarations, ordered boxes and bounded scalar evidence are consumed and returned. Replay reconstructs mathematical questions; no secret or authenticated publication input is admitted.
